about.label: Analog Devices
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company specializing in data conversion, signal processing, and power management technology, headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americká polovodičová firma specializovaná na převod a zpracování signálu a řízení napájení.

about.label: Qualcomm
about.summary: American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. The company develops and designs technologies for global communications and computing, including next-generation mobile networks, smart devices, and semiconductors — such as mobile processors and artificial intelligence chips.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro mobily a bezdrátovou komunikaci a licencuje své patenty.

about.label: Gilead Sciences
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Foster City, California, that focuses on researching and developing antiviral drugs used in the treatment of HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, influenza, and COVID-19. It also develops medicines in therapeutic areas such as oncology and inflammation and cell therapy.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na HIV, žloutenku a rakovinu.

about.label: Shopify
about.summary: Canadian multinational e-commerce company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, that operates a cloud e-commerce management platform for retail point-of-sale systems. Major customers include Tesla, LVMH, Nestlé, PepsiCo, AB InBev, Kraft Heinz, Lindt, Whole Foods Market, Red Bull, and Hyatt.
about.summary_cs: Kanadská firma, jejíž platforma umožňuje obchodníkům založit a provozovat e-shop i prodej na pokladně.

about.label: ASML Holding
about.summary: Dutch company that develops and manufactures photolithography machines used to produce integrated circuits.
about.summary_cs: Nizozemská firma, jediný výrobce litografických strojů, bez kterých nejde vyrábět nejmodernější čipy.

about.label: Western Digital
about.summary: American data storage company headquartered in San Jose, California. Established in 1970, the company is one of the world's largest manufacturers of hard disk drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce pevných disků a úložišť dat.

about.label: Intuitive Surgical
about.summary: American biotechnology company that develops, manufactures, and markets robotic products designed to improve clinical outcomes of patients through minimally invasive surgery, most notably with the da Vinci Surgical System.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí chirurgické roboty da Vinci pro miniinvazivní operace.

about.label: Fortinet
about.summary: American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It develops and sells security products including firewalls, endpoint security and intrusion detection systems.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a další ochranu sítí a zařízení.

about.label: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was one of the first biotech firms to use an explicit strategy of rational drug design rather than combinatorial chemistry.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na cystickou fibrózu a další vážná onemocnění.

about.label: Arm Holdings
about.summary: British semiconductor and software design company headquartered in Cambridge, England, whose primary business is the design of central processing unit cores that implement the ARM architecture family of instruction sets.
about.summary_cs: Britská firma, která navrhuje architekturu procesorů a licencuje ji výrobcům čipů – na jejím návrhu běží téměř všechny mobily.

about.label: Booking Holdings
about.summary: American travel technology company based in Norwalk, Connecticut, that owns and operates several travel fare aggregators and travel fare metasearch engines including namesake and flagship Booking.com, Priceline.com, Agoda, Kayak, Cheapflights, Rentalcars.com, Momondo, and OpenTable.
about.summary_cs: Americká cestovní technologická firma, která provozuje Booking.com, Priceline, Agodu, Kayak, Rentalcars.com a další rezervační služby.

about.label: Automatic Data Processing
about.summary: American multinational provider of cloud-based human resources management, payroll processing, and professional employer organization services, headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
about.summary_cs: Americký poskytovatel cloudových služeb pro personalistiku a zpracování mezd.

about.label: Cadence Design Systems
about.summary: American multinational technology and computational software company headquartered in San Jose, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává software pro návrh čipů a elektroniky.

about.label: Adobe
about.summary: American multinational computer software company based in San Jose, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, autor Photoshopu, Acrobatu a dalších nástrojů pro tvorbu a úpravu obsahu.

about.label: Datadog
about.summary: American company that provides an observability service for cloud-scale applications, providing monitoring of servers, databases, tools, and services, through a SaaS-based data analytics platform.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, jejíž cloudová platforma sleduje provoz serverů, databází a aplikací.

about.label: Constellation Energy
about.summary: American energy company headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland. The company provides electric power, natural gas, and energy management services.
about.summary_cs: Americká energetická firma, která vyrábí a dodává elektřinu a zemní plyn.

about.label: CSX Corporation
about.summary: American holding company focused on rail transportation and real estate in North America, among other industries. The various railroads of the former Chessie System and Seaboard Coast Line Industries that are now owned by CSX Corporation were eventually merged into a single line in 1986 and it became known as CSX Transportation.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje nákladní železniční dopravu na východě USA.

about.label: Monster Beverage
about.summary: American beverage company that manufactures energy drinks including Monster Energy, Relentless, Reign and Burn.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce energetických nápojů, hlavně značky Monster Energy.

about.label: Warner Bros. Discovery
about.summary: American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in New York City.
about.summary_cs: Americká mediální skupina, vlastník filmového studia Warner Bros., HBO a CNN.

about.label: Comcast
about.summary: American multinational mass media, telecommunications, and entertainment conglomerate. Comcast's corporate headquarters is at the Comcast Center in Philadelphia, while NBCUniversal, Comcast's New York operations and other major Comcast assets are headquartered at 30 Rockefeller Plaza in Midtown Manhattan in New York City.
about.summary_cs: Americká mediální a telekomunikační skupina, která nabízí internet a kabelovou televizi a vlastní NBCUniversal.

about.label: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals
about.summary: American biotechnology company headquartered in Westchester County, New York. Originally focused on neurotrophic factors and their regenerative capabilities, giving rise to its present name; the company has since expanded operations into the study of both cytokine and tyrosine kinase receptors, which gave rise to their first product, which is a VEGF-trap.
about.summary_cs: Americká biotechnologická firma, která vyvíjí léky například na oční choroby a astma.

about.label: Mondelez International
about.summary: American multinational confectionery, food, holding, beverage, and snack food company based in Chicago. Mondelez has an annual revenue of about $38.5 billion and operates in approximately 160 countries.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce sladkostí a snacků, mimo jiné značek Milka, Oreo a Toblerone.

about.label: Honeywell
about.summary: American publicly traded, multinational conglomerate corporation headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It primarily operates in three areas of business: building automation, industrial automation, and energy and sustainability solutions.
about.summary_cs: Americký konglomerát, který vyrábí systémy pro letectví, automatizaci budov a průmyslu.

about.label: American Electric Power
about.summary: American domestic electric utility company in the United States. American Electric Power Company is one of the nation's largest generators of electricity, owning nearly 38,000 megawatts of generating capacity in the United States.
industry: electric power generation, transmission and distribution
about.summary_cs: Americká energetická firma, jeden z největších výrobců elektřiny v USA.

about.label: Teradyne
about.summary: American automatic test equipment designer and manufacturer based in North Reading, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce zařízení pro automatické testování čipů a průmyslových robotů.

about.label: Strategy
about.summary: American company that provides business intelligence and mobile software.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která prodává analytický software, ale hlavně nakupuje a drží bitcoin – je jeho největším firemním vlastníkem.

about.label: Fastenal
about.summary: American publicly traded company based in Winona, Minnesota, founded in 1967. Fastenal is a major distributor of industrial and construction supplies, and the largest fastener distributor in North America.
about.summary_cs: Americký distributor průmyslového a stavebního materiálu, největší prodejce spojovacího materiálu (šroubů a matek) v Severní Americe.

about.label: Nebius Group
about.summary: Technology company that provides artificial intelligence infrastructure.
about.summary_cs: Nizozemská technologická firma (vzniklá z mezinárodní části Yandexu), která staví a pronajímá výpočetní infrastrukturu pro umělou inteligenci.

about.label: Baker Hughes
about.summary: American global energy technology company co-headquartered in Houston, Texas and London, UK. As one of the world's largest oil field services, industrial and energy technology companies, it provides products and services to the oil and gas industry for exploration and production, as well as other energy and industrial applications. It operates in over 120 co
about.summary_cs: Americká energetická technologická firma, jeden z největších dodavatelů služeb a zařízení pro těžbu ropy a plynu i další průmysl.

about.label: Diamondback Energy
about.summary: American company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration in the Permian Basin.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která těží ropu a zemní plyn v Permské pánvi v Texasu.
